name: Mohd Shukri Ramli
_note: M2 opposition-executive cohort: Menteri Besar of Perlis from 22 Nov 2022 until his resignation on 25 Dec 2025 (health reasons amid a collapse of assembly confidence). Scored as a tenure-ended period entry, like other mid-period role changes. Added to populate the sub-national-executive class with opposition (PN) executives for the partisan-signal comparison; his weaker, contested record (alongside stronger PN premiers) is exactly the within-coalition variation that makes the partisan test credible. NO coder panel yet, so Layer B is unscored and below ranking validity. Anchor values pending an independent coder panel (minCodersToScore=3). Citations verified via search; full text not opened (fetch restriction); reconfirm against primary sources. B4 and B5 carry no qualifying event and are unscored.

metrics.justification: On 30 Apr 2024 MACC recorded his statement and released him on bail in an abuse-of-power investigation under Section 23 of the MACC Act 2009 over Perlis infrastructure projects since 2022; no charge against him personally was reported, and no public statement formally closing the investigation was located, so the status is recorded as ongoing. A separate, legally distinct case involving his son ended in acquittal in May 2026 (with an MACC appeal) and is not recorded against him.

citation.title: Perlis MB released on MACC bail after 7 hours of questioning

metrics.justification: During the 2024 monsoon floods he reported 8,058 victims in Perlis with RM515,000 spent on essential supplies (NADMA channelling RM236,120 via the state Disaster Relief Trust Account), and later accounted for RM1.92 million spent on food for evacuees. Documented relief response in a small state with mixed capacity (anchor 2).

citation.title: RM1.92mil spent on food for flood evacuees in Perlis, says MB

metrics.justification: His signature industrial-policy initiative, a State Mineral Policy to move Perlis dolomite from raw export to downstream products, remained at the drafting/formation stage at his exit rather than being gazetted and operative. A championed reform left undelivered (anchor 1).

citation.title: Perlis drafting State Mineral Policy - Mohd Shukri

metrics.justification: On 22 Dec 2025, eight PN assemblymen (five Bersatu, three PAS) submitted statutory declarations to the Raja of Perlis withdrawing support; the collapse of intra-coalition confidence in a 15-seat assembly precipitated his resignation and exposed a PAS-Bersatu governing rupture (with PAS terminating three reps' membership). Recorded as erosion of consensus and institutional stability (anchor 1).

citation.title: Perlis assembly may be in limbo after several reps allegedly withdraw support for MB
